content: Rob Chich completed AWS training modules for the 3-Tier VitalStream VPC structure under CAB-01, establishing public, private app, and isolated PHI database subnets.

Rob has 20 years of high-pressure emergency services leadership experience, retiring as a Paramedic Firefighter from the Baltimore City Fire Department where he managed critical operational databases.
Rob's submarine service in the U.S. Navy as an Electronics Technician (1993-1999) formed his core technical baseline, emphasizing risk management and hardware-level diagnostics.
Rob built 'auditbuddy' (https://github.com/2SMOGss/auditbuddy), a Kotlin-based compliance auditor aligned with NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, demonstrating programmatic GRC capabilities.
Rob created 'Cloud-Honeynet-SOC' (https://github.com/2SMOGss/Cloud-Honeynet-SOC), integrating real-time SIEM log collection with threat visualization mapping.
Rob completed Coursera's Google AI Professional Certificate (Credential ID 17183b0e-a6fc-4cc0-abab-e5e349e8dbb8) validating his knowledge in generative AI and prompt engineering.
